name: portfolio-architecture-and-entitlements
steps: Inventory every active product, repository, deployment, service, dependency, integration, protocol, data store, network boundary, security control, observability rail, cost center, entitlement and known risk.
Update the portfolio architecture graph and OpenSpec gaps using authoritative runtime, repository, MCP and web evidence.
Dispatch independent headless coding and research work to OpenCode/DeepSeek and claimed Claude cloud sessions; reserve Codex/Claude local for synthesis and review.
Use browse CLI named sessions for browser work. Escalate to the cua-singleton desktop lane only when browser automation cannot complete the task or an authenticated native desktop is required.

Create approval requests for organization conversion, subscription/reward activation, billing changes, credential creation, or irreversible account mutations. Attach current state, exact proposed click, financial effect and screenshots.

After approval, verify the resulting dashboard state; broker newly created admin credentials directly into Infisical/get-secret and the authorized Paperclip secret reference without logging or chat exposure.
Run an independent evidence review and publish changes, unresolved blockers, expiring entitlements and next highest-value actions.
